component.name: rSshTerm
component.summary: Terminal tabs and splits with an encrypted SSH vault

description.p: rSshTerm is a terminal with tabs and splits whose SSH servers and keys live in one encrypted vault, shared with the iPhone app through Google Drive.

ul.li: Tabs and vertical or horizontal splits, Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 to switch tabs
A built-in ssh-agent: plain ssh in any tab uses the vault's keys
Host search and a jump switcher over open shells and vault servers
A master password opens the vault on a new computer; after that this device's own key does

screenshot.caption: Tabs, a split and an SSH session
